# Pixel Notes App

A concise, offline, accessible pixel-art notes app with three tabs (Work, Home, Ideas). Each tab preserves its text content, highlights the active tab, and shows a character count.

## Features

- Three tabs with persistent textareas
- Character count per tab
- Keyboard-accessible tabs (arrow keys, Home, End)
- ARIA roles and attributes for accessibility
- Pixel-art aesthetic with CSS
- Responsive down to 360px
- No external dependencies or network requests

## Usage

Open `index.html` in any modern browser. Type in the textareas; content is preserved when switching tabs. Character counts update as you type.

## File List

- `index.html` — main HTML structure
- `styles.css` — styling and pixel-art theme
- `script.js` — tab switching and character counting logic
- `README.md` — this file

## Accessibility

- Tabs use `role="tablist"`, `role="tab"`, `aria-selected`, `aria-controls`
- Panels use `role="tabpanel"` and `aria-labelledby`
- Keyboard navigation: Left/Right arrows, Home, End
- Focus indicators and labels provided

## Build Evidence

All files are self-contained; no build step required. Tested at 360px width and in modern browsers.
